card.name: Comma after decreased renal function in elderly
card.fires_on: The comma ending the clause "Because elderly patients are more likely to have decreased renal function" in geriatric-use sections. Also the period after "respond differently from younger subjects".

modes.label: Comma after renal function clause
modes.description: Comma right after the reason clause about elderly patients having decreased renal function, before "care should be taken in dose selection".
modes.example: Because elderly patients are more likely to have decreased renal function<<,>> care should be taken in dose selection,

modes.label: Period after younger subjects
modes.description: Sentence-ending period after the statement that subjects aged 65 and over may not respond differently from younger subjects.
modes.example: to determine whether they respond differently from younger subjects<<.>> Other reported clinical experience has not identified differences

card.plain: It fires on the punctuation at the end of the standard geriatric-use sentences in drug labels, just before the advice on dose selection or the next sentence.
